answer: Flow-capped vouch-graph admission anchors trust in a basalt core of audited seed agents and requires newcomers to earn collateral-backed peer signatures. Verifiers compute max-flow from the core each epoch, so a Sybil cluster hidden behind an onyx mask of fresh keys still chokes on the narrow cut of real attack edges. Attackers incur scarce endorsement capacity and slashable peer capital per identity. Yet bribed operators can bend like a willow to route flow toward fake nodes.
